text:
nina: deploy-bot flagged usw-dedicated canary tail latency and a small uptick in 5xxs during the late change window.

deploy-bot: alert: canary.p99=1.2s (+0.5s), canary_5xx_rate=0.9% (+0.6) over 4m. Auto-rollback suppressed for change-window tag.

paul: What landed in this batch? We merged the allocator tweak + a runtime kernel option.

tara: Allocator tweak + kernel routing. Local bench fine but didn't run full canary soak.

ops_oncall: Given auto-rollback off, propose staged unwind: 25% -> 50% -> full over 30m intervals if metrics don't improve. Keeps canary pinned for debugging. Also loop in legal + CS for customer notice.

nina: Agreed. Paul, apply first stage 25% rollback and post monitor link. Legal, CS: please vet brief note.

deploy-bot: CLI: `redwood traffic set --pool usw-dedicated --route default --split 75:25 --to v2.5.1,v2.4.9` ; `redwood pin --instance canary-usw --version v2.5.1`

paul: Applied. rollout id r-629999-01. monitor: https://telemetry.redwood/prod/usw-dedicated/r-629999-01

cs_lead: Draft approved: "We observed latency regressions during canary. We're partially routing traffic to prior stable while we investigate. No data loss. Ops contact attached." Legal ok.

tara: I'll open a targeted revert PR for the kernel routing and run canary-only redeploy if CI passes.

ops_oncall: +15m update: p99 improved to 620ms overall, 5xxs back near baseline. Keep staged split for 30m then evaluate.

nina: Good. If metrics hold, we'll re-roll remaining traffic and update release notes explaining the temporary toggle change and validation gap.

paul: Closing this thread unless regressions recur. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
